basic_profile.bio: CryptoLurker92 is a cryptocurrency enthusiast who has been dabbling in the world of digital currencies for over a year. Living in Austin, Texas, they spend most of their online hours in the evenings after work as a software developer. With a passion for languages, they have recently taken up learning Esperanto. They are single and enjoy spending their weekends exploring local coffee shops and attending tech meetups.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: CryptoLurker92 has a solid foundation in software development, having graduated with a degree in Computer Science. They have self-taught themselves about cryptocurrencies through online courses and forums. Their interest in languages like Esperanto stems from a desire to connect with diverse cultures.
